M-install-sh.note: Ran on this box over a local http.server serving the draft's zips (LOFT_INSTALL_BASE) into a scratch --prefix. FOUND A DEFECT: the script copied bin/ and default/ only, then handed verify-self the manifest of the whole bundle, which counts a missing file as a failure — 'files: 14 missing', 'the installation does not verify', exit 1 — and the public 2026.8.0 bundle fails the same way, so it shipped broken last month. FIXED in scripts/install.sh (installs the whole bundle, the unit self-update installs): 2026.9.0 draft -> 'files: 22 file(s) match', exit 0; 2026.8.0 public -> 'files: 21 file(s) match', origin matches the signed index. New end-to-end test tests/self_update_swap.rs::install_sh_installs_the_whole_bundle_and_it_verifies (file:// base, Linux x86_64) — passes on the fix, fails on HEAD's script. The fix is uncommitted on this tree pending a branch
